safety.title: Safety & Guard
safety.familySafeModeDescription: Controls the optional local family-oriented layer. Mandatory child-safety protection remains active in every mode.

status.enabled: When enabled, matching requests are blocked locally before the provider is called.
status.disabled: The optional family layer is off. Mandatory child-safety protection remains active; Venice API provider Safe Mode is controlled separately below.
status.localOffProviderOn: Local family filter is OFF, but Venice API provider-side Safe Mode is still ON. Outbound requests include safe_mode: true.
status.bothOff: Both optional filters are OFF and outbound requests include safe_mode: false. Mandatory child-safety protection remains active.
status.filteredLocally: Matching requests are filtered locally before reaching the provider.

safety.effectiveStatus: Effective Status: Local filter: {{local}} | Venice provider filtering: {{provider}}
safety.setMasterPassword: Set Master Password to lock Family Safe Mode
safety.veniceApiSafeModeDescription: Controls the provider-side safemode parameter sent to Venice. This is separate from Family Safe Mode.

errors.cannotDisableDetail: Family Safe Mode must be turned off first.
